_doc: Mastery-style skills. Points: skill_points_per_level per level (start_points at level 1, pre-spent as 'start'). Mastery points unlock tiers and give per_point stats. Skill ranks scale damage by rank_bonus per rank after the first. Modifiers cost 1 point each and need rank 1. Every name lives here; the verse goes in the tooltip.

strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: Three sword swings; the third is heavier.

heavy_blow.name: Heavy Blow
heavy_blow.desc: The third swing deals 50% more and staggers.

descent.name: Descent
descent.desc: Leap to the target and strike where you land.

rebuke.name: Rebuke
rebuke.desc: A word of command: enemies nearby are struck and flee.

echo.name: Echo
echo.desc: A second pulse follows a moment later.

shield.name: Shield of Faith
shield.desc: Raise the shield: projectiles are put out, blows weakened.

quench.name: Quench
quench.desc: Each projectile put out restores 4 life.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: Blows are weakened by a further 15%.

trumpet.name: Trumpet Call
trumpet.desc: A great blast around you that hurls enemies away.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc: Enemies hit are stunned for 1.5 seconds.

radiance.name: Radiance
radiance.desc: Toggle. Light burns enemies around you and mends you; drains glory.
